skills.name: git-commit
skills.description: Craft conventional commit messages by analyzing staged diffs — auto-detects type, scope, and generates the commit command.

skills.name: conventional-commit
skills.description: Structured workflow for generating Conventional Commits-compliant messages using an XML prompt template with validation.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Tiered code review covering security, quality, and performance. Analyses staged and recent changes, applies confidence filtering, and produces a severity-graded report with an approve/warn/block verdict.

skills.name: create-adapter
skills.description: Scaffold a new ai-stash adapter for a new AI tool target — implements the Adapter interface, registers it, and creates tests.

skills.name: add-asset-type
skills.description: Add a new asset type to ai-stash — updates the type union, registry fetcher, both adapters, TUI colour map, and filter hook.

skills.name: add-asset
skills.description: Add a new asset to the ai-stash registry — creates asset files in the correct directory and registers them in registry.json.

agents.name: debug-agent
agents.description: Systematic four-phase debugging agent: assess → investigate → resolve → QA. Reproduces bugs before fixing and writes a final root-cause report.

agents.name: planner
agents.description: Expert planning specialist for complex features and refactoring. Creates detailed, phased implementation plans with exact file paths, risk assessments, and testing strategies.

instructions.name: code-review
instructions.description: Generic code review guidelines covering security, testing, performance, and architecture — prioritised as CRITICAL / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION.

instructions.name: security-owasp
instructions.description: Security-first coding instructions based on OWASP Top 10 — covers injection, access control, cryptography, misconfiguration, and more.

instructions.name: secure-coding
instructions.description: Non-negotiable secure coding standards covering input validation, secrets management, authentication, error handling, dependency hygiene, and PII handling.

commands.name: write-pr-description
commands.description: Generate a structured pull request description from git diff. Produces a reviewer-friendly summary with type-of-change, test plan, and notes sections.

hooks.name: post-edit-typecheck
hooks.description: Runs TypeScript type-checking asynchronously after every Edit or Write on a .ts/.tsx file. Surfaces type errors in the Claude Code output without blocking the main process.

mcpServers.name: github
mcpServers.description: GitHub MCP server. Gives your AI assistant direct access to GitHub APIs — read issues, PRs, files, commits, and repo metadata without leaving the IDE.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: End-to-end development workflow plugin. Bundles a planning agent (opus), conventional commit skill, and pre-push safety hook into one installable Claude Code plugin.
